name: The quiet romantic
description: Soft blush garden roses and cream peonies, layered petals and a gentle silhouette. For an intimate anniversary, a tender birthday gesture or someone you love. Romantic, delicate and affectionate.

name: A little untamed
description: White flowers and expressive green foliage, arranged loosely like a freshly gathered garden. Airy, natural and uncontrived. A thoughtful thank-you or an unexpected just-because gesture for someone who loves the outdoors.

name: After hours
description: Deep burgundy calla lilies, wine-colored flowers and blush accents. Sculptural lines, rich velvet tones and a quietly dramatic silhouette. For an evening celebration, a bold romantic gesture or someone with confident personal style.

name: A gentle presence
description: Quiet ivory roses and soft white flowers with delicate greenery. Understated, peaceful and comforting. A sensitive expression of sympathy, remembrance or support for someone experiencing loss.

name: Golden hour
description: Apricot, peach and buttery yellow flowers in an open, sunlit composition. Warm, radiant and joyful. For a cheerful birthday, a new beginning or congratulations on a happy milestone.

name: The sculptural edit
description: A minimal composition of white calla lilies and clean green lines. Architectural, modern and restrained, with generous negative space. For a design-loving colleague, a contemporary home or an elegant professional thank-you.
